long_biography.plain_text:
Sezgin Baran Korkmaz's move into online fashion involved buying Bukombin, a website where users assembled outfits from different retailers. The platform sent shoppers to those retailers and earned commissions on purchases. Co-founder Can Demirer remained involved after the acquisition, continuing to manage the business and develop its technology.

Korkmaz also proposed taking the shopping experience beyond the screen. His plan used ten buses bought from a failed transport company to let customers try products before ordering online. The approach addressed places with fewer physical shops, while he aimed to expand the site's trading volume before selling it.
